name: Ulysses
tagline: Organize your long-form writing, focus on drafts, and export or publish your finished work.
description:
Ulysses is a writing app for Mac, iPhone, and iPad that combines a calm editor with a library for long-form projects. It helps writers move from notes and drafts to an exported or published final piece without maintaining a separate file for every revision.

Collect sheets in a project, write with markup and focus tools, set a goal, then export a finished document or publish through a supported service. iCloud sync keeps the same library available on Apple devices.

## Features

- Organize drafts and notes into groups and sheets.
- Use a focused editor with markup, writing goals, and revision tools.
- Export to PDF, Word, eBook, and web formats.
- Publish to supported platforms such as WordPress, Substack, and Ghost.

## Where it fits

Ulysses is strongest for people writing articles, books, newsletters, or other ongoing work. Its subscription and library-centered workflow are less attractive if ordinary portable Markdown files are the top priority.

## Privacy and requirements

The app uses iCloud synchronization for cross-device libraries when enabled. Publishing sends selected work to the chosen platform; review each destination’s access and privacy settings. A subscription unlocks editing across supported Apple devices.

## Pricing

Ulysses offers a seven-day trial and costs $39.99 per year or $5.99 per month in the US; regional App Store pricing can differ.
